plain.li: [for] I like that we stop for our days, whatever else is going on.

[for] Say what you like, our days are what make this a colony and not a work camp.
[for,!sombre] People work better for having something to look forward to.

[for,way:feast] I've been saving my appetite for the feast.

[for,sombre] It's right that we stop and remember, every year.

[for] Whatever the day's for, it's good to stop and look at what we've got.

[mixed] Do you ever wonder who'll still remember these days in ten years?

[against] I'd keep the day for the others' sake, though I'd rather be working.
